lines.zh: 展翼滑翔，黑翼掠过荒地。
lines.en: Spread wings and glide, black wings sweep the wasteland.
Fly low, with faint glows in the air.

lines.zh: 绯红血肉，它最爱的食物。
栖息于玄武岩三角洲，静静等待。
lines.en: Perches on the玄武岩三角洲, waiting quietly.
Whispering at night, echoing in the wasteland.

lines.zh: 寻找绯红血肉，维持饱食。
lines.en: Searching for crimson flesh, to stay full.

lines.zh: 荒地与玄武岩三角洲之间翱翔。
lines.en: Soaring between the wasteland and玄武岩三角洲.

lines.zh: 我从不落地，脚干净得很。
lines.en: I never land; my feet stay clean.

lines.zh: 它贴着岩浆坡滑过一道弧
lines.en: It carves an arc along the lava slope.

lines.zh: 爪不落地，全靠气流托着
lines.en: Its claws never touch ground; the air holds it up.

lines.zh: 静默中思考，黑夜的智慧。
lines.en: Silent thoughts, wisdom of the night.

lines.zh: 绯红血肉腐烂，它不会吃。
lines.en: Crimson flesh rots, it won't eat.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，它的家园。
lines.en: 玄武岩三角洲, its home.

lines.zh: 孤独的飞行者，无言的守望。

lines.en: Does not consort with walking kin.

lines.zh: 绯红血肉的气味，它无法抗拒。
lines.en: Cannot resist the smell of crimson flesh.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的守护者。
lines.en: Guardian of the玄武岩三角洲

lines.zh: 瞥见玩家，眼中闪烁贪婪。
lines.en: Player spotted, eyes glint with greed.

lines.zh: 绯红血肉，它是最好的礼物。
玩家，你是我的下一个乘客？

lines.en: Flying low, to see you better.

lines.zh: 它想搭乘客人，不是敌人。
lines.en: Wants a ride, not an enemy.

lines.zh: 玩家手中，绯红血肉的诱惑。
lines.en: Player's hand, the crimson flesh诱惑.

lines.zh: 翅膀振动，准备搭乘客人。
lines.en: Wings fluttering, ready for a ride.

lines.zh: 玩家，你的旅程我来助你。
lines.en: Player, let me help your journey.

lines.zh: 翼膜破了个口，我往下坠。
lines.en: A tear in my wing membrane; I drop.

lines.zh: 翅膀被火烧了，快掉下去。

lines.en: Don't go, I have more to say!
Eat crimson meat, let me carry you.
Crimson flavor, let me be free.
Crimson heart, the price of flight.
Crimson meat, let me carry you.
Crimson blood, the reward of flight.
Collide with me, feel the flight!
Touch me, a moment of flight.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，两人都在半空打转
lines.en: You hit it and both of you spin in midair.
King of flight, find a mate.
Find a mate, share the skies.
Be with me, fly through the Nether.
King of flight, find a love.
Flying mate, dance in the sky.

lines.zh: 绯红血肉滑入口中，肉感十足。
lines.en: Scarlet flesh melts in mouth, juicy.

lines.zh: 飞行滑翔，翅膀闪着红光。
翅膀一振，绯红之影掠过。
翅膀振动，绯红血肉飘落。
它以绯红血肉充饥，满足了。
绯红的翅膀在夜空中闪烁。
绯红的羽翼与赤红之肉相连。
它掠过地表，寻找绯红血肉。

lines.en: It spread wings, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，绯红之影逼近。
它的翅膀中隐藏着致命攻击。
它的翅膀上闪烁着致命光芒。
它认出你手里那块绯红肉
lines.en: It recognizes the crimson flesh in your hand.
I never land. Too lazy to dirty my feet.
A beat of its wings and it changes course.

lines.zh: 它从玄武岩柱后转出来
lines.en: It sweeps out from behind a basalt pillar.

lines.zh: 它准备飞临你上方，展开攻击。
lines.en: It prepares to swoop, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它注视着你，寻找最佳时机。
lines.en: It watches, seeking the right moment.
It seeks the chance to strike.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，等待时机。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 它准备趁你不备发起攻击。
lines.en: It prepares to attack when you least expect it.
It focuses, searching for an opening.

lines.zh: 它时刻准备着发起攻击。
它的眼睛盯着你，伺机而动。
lines.en: Its eyes lock on you, waiting.

lines.zh: 它准备趁你放松时发动攻击。
lines.en: It’s ready to strike when you relax.
It circles overhead, waiting for meat.
It will land three paces in front of you.

lines.zh: 尖叫一声，翅膀一展，俯冲下来！
lines.en: Screams and dives with wings spread.

lines.zh: 血肉鲜红，它却轻盈如风！
lines.en: Fleshy, yet it flies like a breeze.
Grasps, but leaves only air behind.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的重量，却触不可及。
lines.en: You feel its weight, but not its touch.
Scarlet flesh, its source of life.

lines.zh: 被憎恨的飞行者，俯冲而下。
它的飞行，比飞翔还自由。
每一次攻击，都是生命的代价。
翅膀兜过来，扇你一脸热风
lines.en: A wing sweeps past, blasting hot air at you.
Its claws rake toward your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它从背后擦过，扯住你的披风
lines.en: It skims past behind you, snagging your cloak.

lines.zh: 它俯冲的力道把你推下坡
lines.en: The force of its dive shoves you down the slope.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，它的翅膀悄然张开。

lines.en: In Nether wastes, it soars free.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，它寻找猎物。
lines.en: 玄武岩三角洲, it hunts here.

lines.zh: 它的存在，令地面生物不安。
绯红之肉，它唯一的依仗。
我在玄武岩上飞，脚从不脏。
lines.en: I glide over basalt. My feet stay clean.

lines.zh: 热风一乱，它从荒地升起
lines.en: The hot wind eddies and it rises from the wastes.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱间，一抹影子张开
lines.en: Between basalt pillars, a shadow spreads its wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀一沾水，我只能下沉。
lines.en: Wings wet. I can only sink.
Too hungry to beat my wings.
Lightning struck my thin wings and left them numb.

lines.zh: 翅膀掉进虚空中，摔死的。
